author: Nicetomitja77
quote: Let’s set aside the massive performance issues for now. What could be better than running around in a game to get period products for your toxic girlfriend after a long day at work? GTA has lost its soul and has become a “woke,” boring, and degrading game that celebrates hatred toward men. The development team consists almost entirely of women and blue-haired they/thems, and it shows. GTA is dead.
